messages:
maria: Flagging a small but noisy problem from yesterday's v2 rollout: customers report their dashboards showing v2 token billing while traces show v1 served for some requests. Looks like routing fallbacks + implicit pinning interacting badly.

kevin: Saw it too. The fallback path will switch variants mid-session when v2 capacity dips. Billing currently attributes per-write, which leads to the same logical session being split across ledgers.

olivia: Proposal: make attribution deterministic by default during rollouts. Two parts: 1) server honors an optional `X-Redwood-Session` header (generated by SDK) and attributes tokens to the first-seen variant for a configurable grace window (default 45s). 2) Emit low-cardinality telemetry `compat.attribution` with (tenant, route, session_hint, decision) for correlation.

devex-sam: +1. Also add a Console toggle per-tenant: "Stable attribution mode" (on by default for Dedicated) which enables the grace window. Console should show a small tooltip: "When on, tokens for a short period are billed to the initial variant to avoid split-session invoices." Add a link to migration docs.

ops-bot: alert: attribution-jitter spike for tenant: delta-llc (route /chat) +11% over 30m

maria: For SRE we need an admin debug endpoint `/internal/debug/session_attribution?session_id=` that returns variant timeline and metric diffs. Must be admin-only.

kevin: Implementation detail: routing layer sets `session_origin_variant` tag on the request event. Billing pipeline reads that tag to attribute usage. We'll gate the change behind FF `compat.stable_attribution`.

olivia: Also need to avoid counting retries twice. Dedupe rule: if same `request_id` appears across variants within grace window, count once and attribute to origin. Emit `compat.dedupe` metric when this happens.

devex-sam: SDKs should expose a helper to auto-generate `X-Redwood-Session` and fallback to cookie-based session if not present. Docs: explain behavior, how to opt-out, and how the Console toggle maps to billing.

maria: UX ask: Console timeline per-route showing "attribution mode" changes (on/off) and a small CSV export of reconciled events for support. Also banner during rollouts: "Attribution stable mode active" with an explainer.

kevin: Rollout plan: 1) Telemetry event schema + debug endpoint (this week). 2) SDK helper + header guidance (docs + migration note). 3) Billing pipeline: `session_origin_variant` tag read + FF (staged next week). 4) Console toggle + banners after backend stable.

olivia: I'll open PRs for header/telemetry. Can we make the default grace window configurable per-tenant via Console (min 5s, max 300s)? Some customers want short windows.

devex-sam: Good idea. We'll add slider in route config. Also I'll draft the migration FAQ and customer email for Dedicated customers.

maria: Thanks team. Once canary telemetry looks clean we'll flip FF for a small cohort and validate ledger parity. :thumbsup:
